market_question: Will Neymar play in the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
reasoning: Neymar returned to Brazil's squad in March 2025, scoring in a qualifier, proving he's in the coach's plans for the 2026 cycle. However, he will be 34 at the tournament and has a long history of severe injuries (2023 ACL, multiple foot/metatarsal fractures) that make further setbacks likely. The 14-month gap to the World Cup introduces significant fitness risk, so fair value is closer to 70% rather than the market's 77.5%.
evidence_points: Neymar suffered an ACL tear in October 2023 and missed a full year of football.
He returned to the Brazil national team in March 2025, scoring against Colombia, and appears reintegrated under coach Dorival Júnior.
At age 34 and with a lengthy injury dossier, the probability of missing the 2026 World Cup through another injury is material, even if he only needs a single appearance to settle the market.
